title: Complex algebra of holomorphic germs at the origin
statement: For $d\in\mathbf N$, let $A_d$ be the $\mathbf C$-subalgebra of functions $f:\mathbf C^d\to\mathbf C$ analytic at $0$, with analyticity and pointwise operations as in [lem-sfb-complex-analytic-function-operations]. Let $K_d$ be the ideal of representatives zero on some open neighbourhood of $0$. Define the holomorphic germ algebra $G_d=A_d/K_d$. Thus two representatives determine the same germ exactly when they agree on some open neighbourhood of $0$; a function on an open neighbourhood is represented by any total extension. Let $[f]\mapsto f(0)$ be evaluation, $z_i=[x\mapsto x_i]$ for $i\in\{1,\ldots,d\}$ the coordinate germs, and $\mathfrak q_d$ the kernel of evaluation.

source.place: Serre GAGA no.4, printed p.6, holomorphic local algebra; read online https://www.numdam.org/article/AIF_1956__6__1_0.pdf.
